review_axes.finding: Alias disjointness and reachable-counterexample rule are specified and resolve the V4 lexical-label conflation in principle. However, six actions contain textual effects without fully typed preconditions, admissible state, transition/invariant/priority rules; no mapping from all four task categories and target/qualifier slots to the action ontology is frozen. Thus it is not source-verifiable that within-domain genuine structural OOD is distinguishable from ontology-induced coverage failure.
review_axes.must_fix: In one prospective amendment, freeze finite state types, action pre/postconditions, guards, goal/time/priority interpretation, slot schema, category-to-action coverage table, and paired concrete reachable/nonreachable and alias counterexample fixtures. Explicitly label unrepresentable categories as OUT_OF_SCOPE/HOLD, never OOD PASS.

review_axes.finding: TIME must be emitted by the model; it cannot be filled from gold. A typed finite lexicon, multiword aliases and exact tuple scoring are prospectively defined. Grammar remains schematic, so parser and 64/64 positive plus >=64 negative adversarial QA are not established.
review_axes.must_fix: Implementation gate: freeze complete multiword/longest-match tokenization, NONE TIME surface, phrase boundaries, qualifier/target disambiguation, output-only parsing and invalid/negated/quoted/truncated cases; pass independent synthetic tests before science.

review_axes.finding: Twelve fixed unique seeds 20261120..20261201, signed D_s over 256 paired families, D_s>0 strict and ties nonpositive are consistent; exact binomial one-sided k>=10 gives 79/4096. The inference is only a conditional sign probability on 16 fixed OOD skeletons, given actual independent seed-level streams—not a mean >=10pp or broad-OOD population test.
review_axes.must_fix: Implementation gate: byte-validate SHA256 namespace derivation and 64 reproducible sampler decisions, distinct stochastic trajectories across seeds, full no-cherry-pick ledger; if seed dependence/nondegeneracy unverified, suppress inferential p-value and HOLD science.

review_axes.finding: Integer gates are internally consistent: sum D>=308/3072; >=3 of 4 category deltas >=39/768, all 4 nonnegative; C correct >=192/768 each category. These are descriptive predeclared gates, not an inferential >=10pp test.
review_axes.must_fix: Implementation/report gate: disclose all per-skeleton and per-category cells, including regressions and cue-shortcut probes; no post-outcome extra decision thresholds.

review_axes.finding: V5 materially fixes raw-hash dictionary leakage with a private keyed HMAC, per-batch random ID, one-shot ledger and Ed25519 policy. Yet protocol binds TRAIN_VAL_AST in a pre-audit ledger while the signed public receipt only binds audit_id, protocol, checker and eval_hmac; no ledger digest/identifier or TRAIN_VAL commitment is authenticated in the receipt. The auditor must independently verify the HMAC-to-exact-AST binding but the HMAC key is specified as custodian-only, without an attested verification/dual-control path. A crash cannot always generate a signed UNKNOWN. These are protocol/custody-definition gaps, not merely unexecuted security QA.
review_axes.must_fix: Specify an authenticated immutable pre-audit ledger root, include its safe digest/binding and policy/schema versions in signed receipt; define private custodian-to-auditor verification that proves the exact committed EVAL AST without exposing key or private witness publicly, plus key rollover/no-reuse, identity/key pin and state transitions. On crash with no available signer/receipt, ABSENT_RECEIPT=>HOLD (not fictitious signed UNKNOWN). Freeze byte-level JCS/HMAC/Ed25519 test vectors, ASCII-hex audit_id length and NUL-domain encoding before implementation.

review_axes.finding: Independent source #8 directly contains AdamW lr=1e-4, betas .9/.95, wd .1, clip 1, warmup16 to cosine1e-5, batch16x256/4x4 and lambda=.2/tau=1/K=4. V5 prospectively reuses those exact values for a new task and fixes a same-TRAIN-family opposite-condition negative per positive. This is provenance, not evidence of optimality or validated transfer; C-B remains the contrastive package (loss+extra negative supervision+compute), not loss-only/equal-FLOPs. 36 runs/9216 steps/18432 outputs, $0 T4 are unverified.
review_axes.must_fix: Implementation gate: pin exact negative invalidity under positive fact via typed checker (not merely opposite-condition label), B/C episode-byte and CE slot parity, length and rights checks, stochastic nondegeneracy, gradient/resume with nonzero AdamW moments, sampler/runner SHA and measured Free T4 budget; no tuning/seed shopping or fourth arm.
